slides.title: The Highest-Density Floor at a Congress
bullets: Hundreds of researchers present data in a compact, accessible format
The author is often standing right by their poster
That direct conversation is rarely possible after an oral presentation

slides.title: Walking 400 Posters With No Plan Means Reviewing None
bullets: Review the scheduled poster list and published abstracts in advance
Prioritize by relevance to your product or comparator
Prioritize authors who are mapped KOLs or DOLs
Prioritize topics tied to known evidence gaps
Covering 400 posters with no criteria means depth on none of them

slides.title: Poster Authors Are Not Consolidated KOLs
bullets: Many are early-career researchers or emerging scientists
Some are presenting to an international audience for the first time
They are often eager to discuss their methodology and findings in depth

slides.title: A Source of Future Talent and Collaborators
bullets: These conversations often surface early scientific talent
They can identify potential collaborators for future studies
Connects directly to the rising-star identification work from Module 3

slides.title: Ask Beyond What the Poster Shows
bullets: Probe study design, sample size, and acknowledged limitations
Ask how the author interprets the clinical relevance of their own findings
Apply the critical-thinking principles on evidence from Module 6
These conversations often reveal nuance the abstract never mentions

slides.title: Document Before the Value Disappears
bullets: Record every relevant conversation with the same rigor as a formal meeting
Capture the author, the core message, and any nuance or limitation discussed
Note any follow-up opportunity, relational or research-based
Without immediate documentation, dozens of conversations fade within days

takeaway.title: A poster walk is a structured intelligence exercise, not a stroll through a hall
bullets: Prioritizing which posters to visit is what makes depth possible
Author conversations often surface talent and nuance no abstract captures
Immediate documentation is what keeps that value from disappearing
